InitialSuperAdmin._comment: Phase 27 — bootstrap seed for the first SuperAdmin. Idempotent on Email; InitialPassword only applied when no SuperAdmin exists for this Email. Production should rotate this password via /SuperAdmin/Account/ChangePassword on first login (MustChangePassword=true is set on seed).

Email._comment: Phase 30A — outbound SMTP. TestMode=true LOGS instead of sending (safe dev default). Production sets TestMode=false + supplies Username/Password/FromAddress via env vars (Email__Username, Email__Password, Email__FromAddress). For Gmail: 2FA on account + generate App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords + use it as Email:Password. Personal Gmail limit 500/day; for scale switch to SendGrid (TD-110).
